title: 第3102章 前后夹击第3101章 还敢露头
slug: 剑里乾坤第3107章不似作伪
content_zh:
两个打一个，算什么英雄好汉！崖下，四王子目眦欲裂，手中长剑出鞘，便要纵身跃上崖顶。
殿下不可！石万嗔一把拽住他手腕，老脸凝重如铁，指甲几乎掐进四王子肉里，那黑雾有毒，沾之即死！况且——他抬眼望向崖顶，声音低沉如闷雷，带着一丝不易察觉的颤抖，这等层次的交手，咱们上去，不过是添乱。卓少侠……卓少侠自有办法应对。
四王子咬牙，手中长剑握得指节发白，青筋暴起如蚯蚓，却终究没有挣脱。他仰头望去，只见崖顶之上，一黑一白一灰三道身影如流星赶月般交错碰撞，刀光剑影交织成一张密不透风的网，黑雾与剑气纠缠撕扯，竟看不清三人的身形，只能看到三道模糊的残影在漫天光影中飞速穿梭、碰撞、分离，再骤然绞杀在一起！
铛！铛！铛！铛！铛！
密集的撞击声如骤雨敲窗，又如战鼓擂动，震得下方众人耳膜生疼，气血翻涌。修为稍弱者竟当场喷出一口鲜血，连站立都难以支撑，纷纷盘膝坐地，运功抵御那无形的冲击。
崖顶之上，卓然以一敌二，形势已是凶险万分。
厉抗天八十年功力如汪洋大海，每一刀劈出都带着排山倒海之势。万毒刀舞出漫天墨绿刀影，如乌云盖顶，每一刀都裹挟着蚀骨腐肉的剧毒，所过之处草木瞬间枯萎，连坚硬的山岩都被腐蚀出一个个漆黑的深坑，散发出令人作呕的腥臭。刀锋所指之处，空气似被腐蚀，泛起阵阵扭曲的涟漪，如水面被投入巨石。
迦楼罗虽伤势未愈，但龙象般若功的霸道劲力依旧不容小觑。他招式阴毒狠辣，专攻卓然要害，双掌如毒龙出洞，掌风所过之处，连空气都泛起阵阵扭曲的涟漪。每一掌拍出，都带起一阵的尖啸，如万鬼哭嚎，掌风未至，那股腥臭之气已让卓然头晕目眩，内力运转都为之一滞。
小子，你方才的霸气呢？厉抗天狂笑，万毒刀舞出漫天墨绿刀影，如乌云盖顶，将卓然周身退路尽数封死，不是要碾压老夫吗？怎么如今像条丧家之犬，四处逃窜？
卓然身形如鬼魅，在刀光掌影间穿梭闪避。红云白龙剑化作千百道赤银剑芒，剑气纵横如网，却终究难以同时抵挡两大高手的联手夹击。他左肩被迦楼罗掌风扫过，顿时衣衫碎裂，皮肉翻卷，伤口处泛起乌黑之色——龙象般若功的霸道劲力如万千钢针穿刺，痛入骨髓；右腿又被厉抗天刀气擦过，鲜血如泉涌出，染红了半边裤腿，伤口处瞬间泛起乌黑之色，剧毒侵入！
卓然！水月心左臂伤口崩裂，鲜血浸透衣袖，她却浑然不觉，美眸中泪光闪烁，声音嘶哑如裂帛，撑住……你一定要撑住！
叶鼎天站在崖下阴影处，嘴角浮起一抹阴冷的笑意，如毒蛇吐信。他负手而立，望着崖顶上那道浴血奋战的白色身影，心中快意如潮——卓然啊卓然，你纵有通天本领，今日也要葬身于此！他仿佛已经看到卓然被万毒刀斩成两截、被龙象般若功震碎心脉的惨状，嘴角的笑意愈发阴冷。
铛！铛！铛！
金铁交鸣之声震彻云霄，崖顶之上碎石纷飞，草木尽摧。卓然越战越退，已被逼至崖边，身后便是万丈深渊，云雾翻涌如怒海，深不见底。偶有碎石被他脚跟踢落，坠入深渊，许久才传来一声沉闷的回响，如地狱之门缓缓开启。
他浑身浴血，衣衫破碎如布条，被山风吹得猎猎作响。脸上、手臂上、胸膛上，处处是刀伤掌印，鲜血顺着衣角滴落，在岩石上绽开朵朵血花，又被那灼热的真气蒸腾成一缕缕白烟。唯有那双眸子，依旧燃烧着不屈的火焰，如暗夜中的星辰，愈发明亮，愈发明亮——
小子，受死吧！厉抗天眼中闪过一丝狰狞，万毒刀高举过顶，八十年的阴煞功力尽数灌注其中，刀身墨绿光芒大盛，无数毒虫虚影在刀锋上盘旋嘶鸣，发出的细碎声响，听得人头皮发麻，修罗刀法·九幽灭世！
这一刀，凝聚了他毕生功力，刀未落，那股毁灭一切的威压已让崖顶岩石寸寸龟裂，蛛网般的裂痕迅速蔓延开数丈。刀锋所指之处，空气似被腐蚀，泛起阵阵扭曲的涟漪，如水面被投入巨石。与此同时，迦楼罗亦从侧翼暴起，双掌如毒龙出洞，龙象般若功的第十层功力毫无保留地倾泻而出，直取卓然后心要害！
前后夹击，退无可退！
崖下众人骇然失色，四王子嘶声喊道：卓大哥——！
水月心不顾左臂伤口崩裂，玉扇地展开，便要冲上崖顶。盘龙老人一把拽住她手腕，老眼中精光闪烁：月心姑娘，不可！

千钧一发之际，卓然忽然笑了。
那笑容里没有绝望，没有恐惧，只有一种近乎疯狂的决然，如烈火烹油，如雷霆贯耳，如沉睡万年的蛟龙终于苏醒。
好！好！好！他仰天长啸，声震九霄，龙吟之声与啸声交织，在崖顶之上回荡不休，震得山风都为之一滞，既然你们找死，那便成全你们！
他猛地将红云白龙剑从岩石中拔起，剑身带起一串火星，剑尖斜指地面。丹田内真气剧烈翻涌，玉眼赤蛟内丹转速陡增，却不再向外释放灼热光芒，反而将所有力量内敛凝聚，尽数汇入剑身。那股原本外放的炽烈气息骤然收敛，卓然周身竟泛起一层近乎透明的光晕，连呼吸都变得轻不可闻，唯有红云白龙剑剑脊上，赤银二色流光如游丝般急速游走，似在积蓄着某种惊天之力。
“这是……”厉抗天眉头紧锁，心中警铃大作。眼前的卓然看似气息减弱，实则如拉满的弓弦，蕴含着一种让他心惊肉跳的压迫感，他握紧万蛊刀，不敢有丝毫松懈。
此时迦楼罗也已重整气息，从侧后方悄然逼近，双拳紧握，龙象般若功运转到极致，周身肌肉虬结，如铁塔般蓄势待发——他要趁卓然专注应对厉抗天之际，给予致命一击。
content_en:
Two against one, what kind of hero is that? At the bottom of the cliff, the fourth prince's eyes were about to burst. He unsheathed his long sword and was about to jump to the top of the cliff.
Not so, Your Highness! Shi Wanan grabbed his wrist, his old face was as serious as iron, and his nails almost dug into the fourth prince's flesh. The black mist was poisonous, and if you touch it, you will die! Besides - he raised his eyes to the top of the cliff, his voice was as low as thunder, with a hint of imperceptible trembling. In a fight of this level, if we go up, it will just add to the chaos. Zhuo Shaoxia... Zhuo Shaoxia has his own way to deal with it.
The fourth prince gritted his teeth, holding the sword in his hand until his knuckles turned white, and the veins bulged like earthworms, but he did not break free after all. He looked up and saw that on the top of the cliff, three figures, one black, one white, and one gray, intertwined and collided like meteors chasing the moon. The lights of swords and shadows intertwined into an airtight net. The black mist and sword energy were entangled and torn. He couldn't see the figures of the three people clearly. He could only see three blurry afterimages flying, colliding, and separating in the light and shadow in the sky, and then suddenly strangled together!
clang! clang! clang! clang! clang!
The dense impact sound was like a sudden rain knocking on the window, or like the beating of a war drum, which made the eardrums of everyone below hurt and their blood surge. Those with weaker cultivation skills spat out a mouthful of blood on the spot and could not even stand upright. They sat cross-legged on the ground and used their skills to resist the invisible impact.
On the top of the cliff, Zhuoran was fighting one against two, and the situation was already extremely dangerous.
Li Kangtian's eighty years of skill are like a vast ocean, and every sword strike carries an overwhelming force. The dark green shadow of the Ten Thousand Poison Knife danced across the sky, like a dark cloud covering the sky. Each knife was wrapped in the poison that corrodes bones and rotten flesh. The vegetation withered instantly wherever it passed, and even the hard rock was corroded into deep black pits, emitting a disgusting stench. Where the blade points, the air seems to be corroded, with twisting ripples appearing, like huge rocks thrown into the water.
Although Garuda's injury has not healed, the domineering power of Dragon Elephant Prajna Kung Fu cannot be underestimated. His moves are vicious and vicious, specializing in Zhuoran's vital points. His palms are like poisonous dragons coming out of their holes. Wherever the wind of the palms passes, even the air will be filled with distorted ripples. Every time a palm was struck, there was a burst of screams, like the wails of thousands of ghosts. Before the wind of the palm came, the stinky smell had already made Zhuo Ran dizzy, and the movement of his internal energy was stagnant.
Boy, where was your domineering attitude just now? Li Kangtian laughed wildly, and the ten thousand poisonous swords danced out with dark green sword shadows all over the sky, like dark clouds covering the sky, blocking all Zhuoran's escape routes. Didn't he want to crush me? Why are you running around like a lost dog now?
Zhuoran's figure was like a ghost, dodging between the light of swords and the shadows of his palms. The red cloud white dragon sword turned into thousands of red and silver sword lights, and the sword energy was as vertical and horizontal as a net, but it was ultimately difficult to withstand the joint attack of the two masters at the same time. His left shoulder was swept by the wind of Garuda's palm, and his clothes were torn into pieces, his flesh was rolled up, and the wound turned black. The overbearing power of the Dragon Elephant Prajna Kung Fu was like thousands of steel needles piercing the bone, and the pain penetrated into the bone marrow. His right leg was wiped by Li Kangtian Sword Qi, and blood gushed out like a spring, staining half of his trouser legs. The wound instantly turned black, and the poison invaded!
Zhuoran! The wound on Shui Yuexin's left arm burst open, and blood soaked into her sleeve, but she was completely unaware of it. Tears flashed in her beautiful eyes, and her voice was as hoarse as cracked silk. Hold on...you must hold on!
Ye Dingtian stood in the shadow under the cliff, a cold smile appeared on the corner of his mouth, like a poisonous snake spitting out a message. He stood with his hands behind his hands, looking at the white figure fighting blood on the top of the cliff, his heart filled with joy - Zhuoran, Zhuoran, even if you have extraordinary abilities, you will die here today! He seemed to have seen the tragic scene of Zhuo Ran being cut into two pieces by the Ten Thousand Poison Knife, and having his heart broken by the Dragon Elephant Prajna Kung Fu, and the smile at the corner of his mouth became even colder.
clang! clang! clang!
The sound of gold and iron clashing shook the sky, gravel flew from the top of the cliff, and vegetation was destroyed. Zhuo Ran retreated more and more as he fought, and was forced to the edge of the cliff. Behind him was an abyss, with clouds and mist rolling like an angry sea, bottomless. Occasionally, some gravel was kicked off by his heel and fell into the abyss. After a long time, there was a dull echo, like the door of hell slowly opening.
He was covered in blood, and his clothesThe shirt was torn like strips of cloth and rustled in the mountain wind. There were knife wounds and palm prints everywhere on his face, arms, and chest. Blood dripped down the corners of his clothes, blooming on the rocks, and then evaporated into wisps of white smoke by the hot Qi. Only those eyes are still burning with unyielding flames, like stars in the dark night, getting brighter and brighter——
Boy, suffer death! A trace of ferocity flashed in Li Kangtian's eyes. He raised the Ten Thousand Poison Knife high above his head, pouring all eighty years of Yin Sha skills into it. The dark green light of the blade shone brightly. Countless poisonous insect shadows circled and hissed on the blade. The crackling sound made people's scalp numb. Shura Knife Technique: Jiuyou Destroy the World!
This knife was the culmination of his lifelong skills. Before the knife fell, the pressure that destroyed everything had cracked the rocks on the top of the cliff, and the spiderweb-like cracks quickly spread for several feet. Where the blade points, the air seems to be corroded, with twisting ripples appearing, like huge rocks thrown into the water. At the same time, Garuda also burst out from the flanks, his palms came out of the cave like poisonous dragons, and the tenth level of Dragon Elephant Prajna Kung Fu poured out without any reservation, going straight to Zhuo Hou's vital point!
Attacked from both front and back, there is no way to retreat!
Everyone under the cliff turned pale with shock, and the fourth prince shouted in a hissing voice: Brother Zhuo——!
Shui Yuexin ignored the cracked wound on her left arm, unfolded her jade fan, and rushed to the top of the cliff. Old Panlong grabbed her wrist, his old eyes flashing: Miss Yuexin, no!
At the critical moment, Zhuoran suddenly smiled.
There was no despair or fear in that smile, only an almost crazy determination, like a burning fire cooking oil, like thunder piercing the ears, like a dragon finally waking up after sleeping for thousands of years.
good! good! good! He looked up to the sky and roared, the sound shook the sky, the dragon's roar intertwined with the roar, echoing endlessly on the top of the cliff, shaking the mountain wind. Since you are seeking death, then I will grant you a favor!
He suddenly pulled the Red Cloud White Dragon Sword out of the rock, the sword body brought up a string of sparks, and the sword tip pointed diagonally at the ground. The true energy in the dantian surged violently, and the speed of the jade-eyed red dragon inner elixir increased sharply, but it no longer released the scorching light outwards. Instead, all the power was condensed and concentrated into the sword body. The fiery aura that was originally released suddenly converged, and an almost transparent halo appeared around Zhuoran's body. Even his breathing became inaudible. Only on the ridge of the red cloud and white dragon sword, the red and silver light moved rapidly like a gossamer, as if it was accumulating some kind of shocking power.
"This is..." Li Kangtian frowned, alarm bells ringing in his heart. The Zhuoran in front of him seemed to have weakened aura, but in fact it was like a fully drawn bowstring, containing a sense of oppression that made his heart beat with fear. He tightened his grip on the Ten Thousand Gu Knife, not daring to relax at all.
At this time, Garuda had also regained his breath and was approaching quietly from the side and behind. With his fists clenched, the Dragon Elephant Prajna Kung Fu was operating to the extreme, and the muscles all over his body were taut and ready to attack like an iron tower - he wanted to take advantage of Zhuo Ran's concentration on dealing with Li Kangtian to deliver a fatal blow.
